title: Counting the Days of Cover Bought on a Certificate
content:
The days of cover bought on a certificate of the Travel Protection Plans are counted from a day that
depends on whether the certificate was issued before the journey began, and on whether the journey has ended.

## The three readings

| The certificate and the journey | The days of cover bought |
|---|---|
| The certificate was issued before the first date of the journey | Counted from the day the certificate was issued to the last date of the journey, both counted |
| The certificate was issued on or after the first date of the journey, and the journey has not ended | Counted from the day the certificate was issued to the last date of the journey, the last date counted |
| Neither of those | The days of the journey, its first and last both counted |

## The counts compared on hypothetical dates

A journey runs from the 10th to the 19th. A certificate issued on the 1st gives, under the first reading, a
count from the 1st to the 19th with both counted, which is 19 days. A certificate issued on the 12th on a
journey that has not ended gives, under the second reading, a count from the 12th to the 19th with the last date
counted and the 12th not, which is 7 days. A certificate issued on the 12th on a journey that has already ended
falls to the third reading, and the count is the days of the journey, the 10th and the 19th both counted, which
is 10 days.
